verdict.rationale: SigNoz is open source and self-hostable with full control of the data plane, and it ingests data over standard OpenTelemetry/OTLP, which limits lock-in on the collection side. The evidence also shows dashboards can be downloaded as JSON, panels exported as CSV, raw data queried with ClickHouse SQL, and service accounts used for programmatic API access. However, nothing documents exporting all stored traces, logs, metrics and alerts in open formats, so leaving would rely on workarounds. Missing for 10: a documented bulk export of all stored telemetry in open formats, documented export of alerts and other configuration, and independent or hands-on confirmation of a complete exit path.
